listing.name: Need for Speed: Carbon (Xbox 360) — ReCarbon (retronative)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Upstream early development, playable in parts, unreleased. Fifteen-minute free roam and one completed AI career race with restart progress reported; repeated route, keyboard controls, physics/frame-pacing and picture/audio acceptance remain pending. Physical controller unverified; unexplained stalls. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Need for Speed Carbon Xbox 360 disc, with its executable extracted to game/files/default.xex. The title ID is 454107EC. The project provides an installer manifest with full-file SHA-256 values; this guide does not include the exact source revision or digest.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: On Apple Silicon, follow setup_tools.sh and survey.sh, build the native ReCarbon target with CMake, then use --install with your own image. App packaging is documented, but there is no public release. The bundled libraries require macOS27. This guide does not establish a downloadable player package.

warnings: Upstream early development, playable in parts, unreleased. Fifteen-minute free roam and one completed AI career race with restart progress reported; repeated route, keyboard controls, physics/frame-pacing and picture/audio acceptance remain pending. Physical controller unverified; unexplained stalls.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
